title: Decompose network rename and queue WebView facades
summary: Splits Queue and Network presentation helpers while preserving namespaced public handlers and safe ordered script initialization.
reason: The active facade split introduced temporal-dead-zone failures during global WebView startup, preventing pages unrelated to Queue or Network from loading.
behavior_before: Queue and Network child factories consumed handlers before those handlers were initialized, and app-level Queue filter binding used a bare compatibility export.
behavior_after: Dependent factories receive initialized handlers or deferred callbacks, and app-level Queue controls use the public Queue namespace without adding exports.
tests_added: ops/scripts/dev/smoke-webview-script-order.mjs namespaced Queue and Network handler assertions
